speaker: Ann
text: Morning everyone, can you hear me?

speaker: Ann
text: So the main topic today is the renewal.

speaker: Bob
text: Claude, what did we agree on price last time?

speaker: Ann
text: I think it was around forty thousand.

speaker: Bob
text: Okay, we decided to go with the annual plan at 38k.

speaker: Ann
text: Great. Let me think aloud for a second about the roadmap.

speaker: Ann
text: Bob will send the contract by Friday.

speaker: Bob
text: Honestly the weather has been terrible this week.

speaker: Ann
text: Read the transcript back to me from the price part.

speaker: Bob
text: Is Claude even listening right now? Funny.

speaker: Ann
text: That was a question for you, by the way.

speaker: Ann
text: We can't sign before legal reviews the DPA, that's a blocker.
